from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FiscalPeriod(BaseModel):
    """Short-term borrowing amounts reported in a single quarterly financial report."""
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The period this report covers (e.g., '2020 Q1', '2020-03-31')")
    reporting_company: str | None = Field(description="The company the report belongs to, as named")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reported period")
    period_start_date: str | None = Field(description="The beginning date of the reported period")
    period_end_short_term_borrowing: float | None = Field(description="Short-term borrowing balance at period end, in CNY")
    period_start_short_term_borrowing: float | None = Field(description="Short-term borrowing balance at period start, in CNY")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the amounts (e.g., 'CNY', '元')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    fiscal_periods: list[FiscalPeriod]
